title: Second nonzero projected D-delta-D boundary Taylor coefficient
question: For a local configuration character and one neighboring canonical Q3 bond, what is the exact third generator difference after the first nonzero second-order coefficient, and what operator degrees must a positive-time orbit estimate control?

model.hamiltonians: H_0=p_q^2/(2*chi)+V_0(q,v), H_1=H_0+B(q,v), where V_0 is a configuration multiplier
model.derivation: L_H(X)=i*[H,X]/hbar on the finite polynomial CCR core
model.first_difference: D'(0)=0 because B and W_a are configuration multipliers
model.degree: F has degree 3, F' degree 2 and F'' degree 1; the third coefficient contains a first-order momentum term with cubic Q3 force coefficient

scope.not_closed: This package closes only an exact finite CCR-core third Taylor coefficient and finite grid component bounds. It does not prove a positive-time evolved-force estimate, a modular-domain estimate, direct D or delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion independence, a common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

adversarial_review.check: The derivation uses L_H=i[H,.]/hbar, p=-i*hbar*partial_q, and W_a=exp(i*a*q/hbar); the signs and hbar factors are checked by direct operator action.
The commutator with (p+a/2)^2 retains the linear a*[F,p] contribution; omitting it would change the 3*a^3*F/(2*chi^2*hbar^2) term.
Any V_0(q,v) configuration multiplier commutes with W_a and the boundary force, so the displayed boundary coefficient is independent of the background potential on the declared core.
D'(0) vanishes, D''(0) is the first force coefficient, and D'''(0) is the next coefficient; no full Taylor summation is inferred.
The rational component ceilings are checked only on the declared 6x6 field grid and are not promoted to an operator bound.
R255 checks exact force derivatives and selected third-coefficient components only; it does not formalize unbounded domains or limits.
Positive-time orbit control, direct D/delta-D, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
